name: 生产消费流程

content.producerFlow: 拦截器→序列化→分区器→缓冲区(RecordAccumulator)→Sender线程批量发送(触发: batch.size满/linger.ms到)
content.retryOrdering: retries重试→可能乱序→解决: max.in.flight.requests.per.connection=1 或 enable.idempotence=true幂等
content.leaderElection: ISR中选新Leader; ISR全挂→unclean.leader.election(true=OSR选/丢数据, false=等到恢复/不丢)
content.replicaSync: Follower FETCH→Leader更新LEO→推进HW(ISR最小LEO=HW边界,消费者可见上限)

rebalance.process: Coordinator触发→Group Leader制定方案(RangeAssignor)→SyncGroup同步→全组恢复消费

content.rangeAssignor: 分区除消费数均分, 余数按consumer名称字典序从前往后分。字典序靠前的多拿

notes: Producer: 拦截→序列→分区→缓冲→Sender异步批量; acks(0/1/all)控可靠性; ISR选Leader; LEO/HW; Rebalance全组停消费
